Analysis.title: Analysis
Analysis.description: A record of an AI image analysis.

uid.description: The ID of the user who performed the analysis.

fileName.description: The name of the analyzed file.

probability.description: The probability score (0-100) that the image is AI-generated.

justification.description: The technical justification for the score.

artifacts.description: A list of visual artifacts found.

createdAt.description: The time the analysis was performed.

/analyses/{analysisId}.description: Stores all analyses performed by users.
